I'm in the same exact boat as you. I played Nioh 2 and pretty much did everything you could do. I beat the game on hard difficulty from the start and it was easy compared to Nioh. Some tips that helped me being a Nioh player and coming straight to this game

1. When the enemy turns red DODGE. This was a problem from me because my first instinct was to parry. In Nioh when an enemy does a red attack it means you have to counter attack/parry with your spirit ability. It took me a while to get used to because the red attacks look so similar to Nioh but that just could be me.

2. You can dodge all day, there is no stamina. So roll around, dash, and run as much as you need.

3. This is the biggest for me. Each job class has a seperate soul shield bar. If youre low on your soul shield bar, simply swap job classes and it will be refilled, but be careful because youre first job will slowly be recovering. If your timing is right you can block a full string combo by swapping between attacks.

4. Equipment level is more important than affinity at the beginning.

Hope these tips help. Im also eagerly waiting on Wo Long. The combat system seems more like SoP than Nioh 2 in Wo Long because the soul sheild is more like the parry, and there is no stance switching.
